sloka: अस्वाधीनम् कथम् दैवम् प्रकारैरभिराध्यते ।स्वाधीनम् समतिक्रम्य मातरम् पितरम् गुरुम् ॥२-३०-३३॥
transliteration: asvādhīnam katham daivam prakārairabhirādhyate ।svādhīnam samatikramya mātaram pitaram gurum ॥2-30-33॥

translations.english: Mother, father and preceptor are present before us. By overstepping them, how can we, in various ways, worship God who is beyond reach (not visible)?
